{"to": ["Dana Whitfield"], "cc": ["Victor Alade"], "subject": "RE: Question on monthly close - line item", "body": "Hi Dana,

Thanks for the question. I looked into the Freight & Handling line in the June report, and the variance you're seeing is a timing item, not a recurring cost.

A late vendor rebate credit of about $18k landed after the statements cut, so it was rebooked into June per our accrual policy. That's what's driving the variance against forecast. I've documented the full breakdown in the close folder so you can see the math.

This is a one-time adjustment — there's no carryover into July. I'll send a short summary to you and Victor by end of day Thursday so you have it in writing before sign-off.

Let me know if you'd like to walk through the numbers on a call.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes", "summary": "Explains June Freight & Handling variance as a timing item from an $18k late vendor rebate credit rebooked per accrual policy, documents breakdown in close folder, confirms no July carryover, and commits to sending a summary to Dana and Victor by Thursday EOD."}
